BillingAutomationId.description: Unique identifier of the billing automation.

Name.title: String update value
Name.description: Name of the billing automation (or null should it not be updated).

Description.title: String update value
Description.description: Description of the billing automation (or null should it not be updated).

Companies.title: Company with billing automation relation array update value
Companies.description: List of companies with relations indicating whether the company should be considered as a travel agency or a company in the reservation. This list can only be empty if the `AssignmentTargetType` is `CompanyAsDetails` or `NoCompany`. Set to null if the value is not updated.

Prepayment.title: Billing automation prepayment type update value
Prepayment.description: Type of prepayment (or null should it not be updated).

AssignmentTargetType.title: Billing automation assignment target type update value
AssignmentTargetType.description: Specifies the type of company assignment to the bill. If set to `NoCompany`, the `BillAggregationType` must be `AggregateByCustomer`. Set to null if the value is not updated.

BillAggregationType.title: Billing automation bill aggregation type update value
BillAggregationType.description: Defines the aggregation target type for billing automation. If not `AggregateByCustomer`, the `AssignmentTargetType` must be `CompanyAsOwner`. Set to null if the value is not updated.

OrderItemConsumptionPeriod.title: Billing automation order item consumption period type update value
OrderItemConsumptionPeriod.description: Specifies the order item consumption period type for the billing automation. Required if the `TriggerType` is recurring. Can be null if the value is not updated.

ProcessingStartOffset.title: String update value
ProcessingStartOffset.description: Processing start offset. Required if the billing automation `TriggerType` is recurring (or null should it not be updated).
